rationale: DARTD18 (OO family closure #613, surfaced by dart-http deep differential): a cascade_section carries SEVERAL invocations (`..transform(tag)..listen((){})` = one section with two selector+argument_part pairs); one calls edge per selector IMMEDIATELY followed by its own argument_part — `..stream().listen((){})..listen((){})` calls stream AND listen, and the earlier keep-the-last-only logic dropped transform/stream. DARTD19: redirecting factories (`factory Reporter() = _Reporter;`) instantiate the implementation class.
